t: You're in the Kingston House estate, in Knightsbridge, just south of Hyde Park. It's a green area of grand terraced houses in the western part of the City of Westminster, near the garden square of Ennismore Gardens. Its Russian Orthodox cathedral has stood there since 1956. The film star Ava Gardner lived here. She was an American actress of Hollywood's golden age, who signed with MGM in 1941 and drew critics' attention in 1946 with her performance in the film noir The Killers.
